allow: PowerShell($ok = $false; for \($i = 0; $i -lt 20; $i++\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 3; $ok = $true; break } catch { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 } }; if \($ok\) { "STATUS: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; $t = [regex]::Match\($r.Content, '<title>\([^<]+\)</title>'\).Groups[1].Value; "TITLE: $t"; "HAS HERO: $\($r.Content -match 'Result-Oriented'\)"; "HAS SERVICES: $\($r.Content -match 'What We Do Best'\)"; "HAS WORKS: $\($r.Content -match 'Selected Works'\)"; "HAS CONTACT: $\($r.Content -match 'Drop Your Next Project'\)"; "HAS FOOTER: $\($r.Content -match 'info@creatolive.com'\)" } else { "SERVER NOT RESPONDING" })

PowerShell($ok = $false; for \($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3001" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 3; $ok = $true; break } catch { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 } }; if \($ok\) { "STATUS: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; "HAS HERO: $\($r.Content -match 'Result-Oriented'\)"; "HAS TAGLINE: $\($r.Content -match 'What We Do Best'\)"; "HAS WORKS: $\($r.Content -match 'Selected Works'\)"; "HAS GROW: $\($r.Content -match 'Who We Help Grow'\)"; "HAS CONTACT: $\($r.Content -match 'Drop Your Next Project'\)"; "HAS FOOTER: $\($r.Content -match 'info@creatolive.com'\)" } else { "SERVER NOT RESPONDING" })
